Name: Crowcalypse
Author: stardemod
Description:
In the bustling world of Stardew Valley, the mischievous crows have taken their thievery to new heights! Introducing Crowcalypse, a mod that adds a twist to your daily farm life. No longer content with merely stealing crops, these cunning birds now snatch anything they can get their beaks on!

Every day, thousands of crows descend upon Stardew Valley, wreaking havoc as they pilfer items from every corner of the valley. From valuable resources to prized possessions, nothing is safe from their grasp. Your farm, once a tranquil haven, is now a battleground as you fend off these feathered bandits and protect your hard-earned belongings.

With Crowcalypse, prepare to face a new challenge as you navigate the chaotic aftermath of the crows raids. Can you outsmart these clever thieves and reclaim your peace? Or will you fall victim to their relentless plundering? The choice is yours in this thrilling mod for Stardew Valley.

Features:
[list]
[*]Crow raids: Experience daily crow raids with thousands of birds swarming each location.
[*]Expanded theft: Crows will steal a wide range of items, not just crops.
[*]Challenge mode: Test your skills in this challenging twist on Stardew Valley gameplay.
[/list]
Details:
Crows will be notorious for their indiscriminate thievery, snatching up a variety of items across Stardew Valley. They target buildings, objects, debris, terrain features like trees, fences, flooring, grass and crops, as well as resource clumps such as stumps, logs, meteorites and boulders. However, they only pilfer resource clumps if the player's tools meet the required upgrade level; otherwise, it would be too easy. Additionally, furniture is not safe from their grasp.
New feature: Animals can now be stolen. The player's inventory is now susceptible to theft including money.

Certain structures, including the farmhouse, shipping bin, pet bowl and greenhouse, are exempt from theft. Likewise, specific objects like the Mushroom Box in the Farm Cave and Feed hoppers inside the barn and coop remain untouched. Non-playable characters such as your children, pets and other villagers are not subject to theft (children are abductable as of version 1.4.0). The player character is also immune to abduction. The goal is not to make the game difficult, but rather enjoyable.

Players have a grace period of 5 days to establish their farm and reach Farming Level 1, providing them with the opportunity to craft scarecrows. Scarecrows are the sole defense against the marauding crows. Interestingly, even scarecrows themselves are not immune to theft unless protected by another scarecrow.

Crows will only visually appear on the farm. This is to prevent long loading times when transitioning to a new day.

As of version 1.4.0 you can configure the number of crows that will descend upon your farm, adjust the length of the grace period before the crows arrive, specify what elements they will be targeting for theft, and even exclude specific items from their pilfering. Simply launch the game once, and the configuration file will be automatically generated within the mod directory.

Hint: [spoiler]- Protect the interior of your house with 2 scarecrows; otherwise, your bed will be stolen.
- Establish a secured area on your farm early and set up a tree nursery. Once the crows start, acquiring tree seeds will become almost impossible.
- Incubators within the barn and coop can be stolen. Protect this object, or your building will become useless.
- If something is wearing a hat and gets stolen, the hat is gone forever. So be careful with the unique hats.
[/spoiler]
